data.one_liner: A package to parse ISO 8601 duration strings.
data.what_it_does: Parses ISO 8601 duration strings in either PnW or PnYnMnDTnHnMnS formats. It returns an ISODuration object that allows access to individual duration fields and provides a human-readable string representation.
use_when: You need to parse ISO 8601 duration strings into structured data
You want to extract years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, or seconds from a duration string
avoid_when: You only need standard Dart Duration objects without ISO 8601 string parsing requirements
strengths: Supports both PnW and PnYnMnDTnHnMnS formats
Provides individual fields for all ISO duration components
weaknesses: Limited to ISO 8601 duration parsing and formatting
